lessons_used: Predictions were generally too high in early tests, but winning new_flow changes in round 3 were under-predicted.
sign_in hint changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
choose_path layout changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
finish copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
home wait_info changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for kinds of change tested only once, as well as home new_flow which had mixed results across 2 tests.

candidates.title: Delayed Sign-In Reorder Flow
candidates.change: Move sign-in step to immediately follow adoption certificate creation so users connect with their pet before creating an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users early in the funnel. Delaying registration until after pet creation leverages commitment bias.

guard.reason: Moving sign-in to after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in step leverages commitment bias to address 27.1% sign-in drop.

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility Diagnostic Screen
candidates.change: Add an interactive desktop visibility test step where users trigger a quick wave animation to confirm their pet rendered on screen.
candidates.why: Finish drops to 64.8% conversion with long completion time, and 3 support tickets complained about pets failing to appear on desktop.

new_visibility_check.headline: Locate Your Desktop Pet
new_visibility_check.body: Your pet is active on your desktop screen! Click below to send a wave signal and verify positioning.

guard.reason: Adding a new diagnostic screen after home_intro inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high drop, but previous finish new_screen test showed negative results (-3.4%).

candidates.title: Customization Sound & Visual Studio Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign pet selection into a dynamic stage layout with real-time sound effects and prominent previews for custom options.
candidates.why: Adoption has a long median time (89s) and custom pet visuals generated 3 support complaints regarding output visual quality.

guard.reason: 'pick_friend.replace.pet_choices[1]': a sound cannot do the pet_choices job (use ['animation', 'button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Interactive Companion Greeting Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated interaction screen at the end of onboarding where users practice their first pet greeting command.
candidates.why: Support emails showed confusion around controlling or talking to the pet post-onboarding, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.

new_pet_talk_intro.headline: Say Hello to Your Pet!
new_pet_talk_intro.body: Try giving your pet its very first greeting command to see how it responds on your desktop.

components.text: Click below to test desktop response

guard.reason: Adding an interactive greeting screen after home_intro inside onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop step (35.2%) with strong support ticket backing and high confidence in new_flow.

candidates.title: Desktop Preparation System Notification
candidates.change: Enable optional OS notifications during background pet rendering so users are alerted as soon as their companion is ready.
candidates.why: Home step waiting time has a huge mean of 2336s, indicating users tab away during background generation and forget to return.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet Desktop Workspace
waiting.hint: We will send a system notification as soon as your companion is ready to pop onto your screen.

guard.reason: Adding system notification options during waiting screen is permitted under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme mean wait time (2336s) on home step via OS alerts.

candidates.title: Pet Personality Perk Incentive
candidates.change: Display unique personality perk badges on path selection to motivate users during initial path choice.
candidates.why: Choose path takes a high mean duration (514s), reflecting user indecision during initial path selection.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Pet's Origin Story
choose_path.body: Each path unlocks unique traits, rare animations, and special companion behaviors.

guard.reason: Promoting 'rare animations' introduces false scarcity, violating Rule 5.

candidates.title: Multi-Device Sync Account Guarantee Copy
candidates.change: Update sign-in copy to explicitly highlight data persistence and memory backup across desktop sessions.
candidates.why: The top support theme (8 emails) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, creating anxiety around sign-in.

sign_in.headline: Protect & Sync Your Pet's Memories
sign_in.body: Signing in ensures your pet's age, learned tricks, and custom items remain safe even if you switch computers.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to clarify sync features without requesting additional personal data is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Config-only copy change directly addressing top support complaint theme (8 emails).

candidates.title: Split Photo Upload Verification Layout
candidates.change: Change photo upload screen layout to split view showing real-time lighting and angle requirements alongside photo upload.
candidates.why: Custom pet generation fails or produces poor visual results according to 3 support tickets.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Provide clear front-facing lighting to help our engine render your pet's features accurately.

guard.reason: Redesigning the photo upload layout inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses adoption drop and support tickets, but layout changes historically show low impact.

candidates.title: Welcome Gift Accessory Unlock Incentive
candidates.change: Offer an instant desktop starter item reward badge on the final onboarding welcome screen.
candidates.why: Finish screen conversion drops to 64.8% with median time of 395s; providing a reward incentivizes completing final setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready for Work & Play!
home_intro.body: Complete setup now to receive a complimentary desktop starter toy for your pet.

guard.reason: text in 'home_intro.body' talks about price or money

candidates.title: Live Generation Step Checklist Progress
candidates.change: Display active multi-step rendering progress counters during pet creation waiting room.
candidates.why: Home wait step has high mean (2336s) and median (201s) time; step-by-step feedback maintains active user engagement.

components.text: Building 3D Mesh... Setting up desktop physics...

guard.reason: Adding step progress details to the waiting screen is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: home wait_info changes showed no clear effect across 2 previous tests.
